description: The live listings in the categories, plus the listings whose text contains the words of the need. Each listing has the TypeSafe score when one is already cached for this need, and it scores no listing. Without categories, the tool finds the category of the need first (one AI call). When the need fits more than one category, it returns `choices`: call again with one or two of them. Pass the returned `categories` to shortlist, so that it does not find the category again. Each listing has vendorPrice: the price that the vendor states, not a price of Shortlist SaaS.

categories.description: One or two category slugs from list_categories. Leave it out to let the tool find the category of the need.

need.description: What the person needs from a SaaS product, in plain words. For example: track the visits to my website.

name: search_listings
title: Search listings
